title: agent-kit project manifest (kit.json) v1
description: Tells the agent-kit plugins where a project keeps its docs, ledger and glossary, and which commands check, test and build it.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion.

project.description: Short project name, used in ledger records and messages.

baseBranch.description: Branch that work items land on.

itemPrefix.description: Prefix of work-item ids, as in APP-123.

ledger.description: Whether the session plugin keeps a ledger record for each session.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths the plugins read and write. Forward slashes, no leading slash.

evolution.description: Evolution pages (process-evolution.md, features-evolution.md): how the way of working and the features grew. The session plugin's `evolution` command and /close-out keep them current once they exist.

commands.description: Shell commands the plugins run, from the repo root. Leave one out when the project has no such step.

install.description: Installs dependencies in a fresh checkout or worktree. Left out: the session plugin guesses from the lockfile.

dev.description: Starts the dev server (on devServer.port), for a session without the desktop app's Browser pane.

commit.description: Commit helper, when the project has its own.

land.description: Lands a finished branch on baseBranch.

commitAudit.description: Run after each commit that holds code; its output is shown to the agent. {files} is replaced by the committed paths, each quoted; the same paths are in KIT_COMMIT_PATHS, one per line. Leave out for none.

commitMessage.description: Checks the commit message before the commit helper commits (the project's commit rules, as its CI checks them). {file} is replaced by the quoted path of a file holding the message; without it the path is appended. A non-zero exit refuses the commit and shows the output. Leave out for none.

evolutionRender.description: Renders one evolution page to its printable version (a PDF), run by `evolution bump` after a version change. {page} is replaced by the quoted repo-relative path of the page; without it the path is appended. Leave out when the project has no renderer.

lintOnEdit.description: Lints each file an Edit or Write call changes (core's lint-edited-file hook). One rule, or a list of rules so different files get different checks; every rule whose match fits the file runs. A failure is shown to the agent; the edit stays.

checks.description: Named check suites for /core:check <name>: each a list of commands run in order from the repo root. A name may not repeat a commands key or `all`.

preflight.description: Optional steps a project wants run now and then before committing (a docs review, an audit). The session plugin counts the commits made since each step last ran and shows the count after a commit; `preflight run <id>` runs the step and clears its count.

description.description: What the step checks and how to run it when it has no command (for example a skill name).

command.description: Run from the repo root by `preflight run <id>`; exit 0 clears the count. Left out: the step runs another way, and `preflight done <id>` clears the count.

match.description: Only commits touching one of these globs count. Left out: every commit with code.

remindAfter.description: Show the count after a commit once it reaches this many.

hooks.description: Per-project control of kit hooks. Plugins can't be switched off hook by hook, so each kit hook reads this list and exits quietly when named.

off.description: Hook ids to skip in this project, as each plugin's docs name them.

release.description: How `kit release` cuts a release of a kit's own repo by moving its tag: where the notes live, what to check, and for an overlay the base-kit release it needs.

check.description: Run from the repo root before the release commit, on the written notes; a failure refuses. Default: commands.check.

notes.description: Files that record each release, all cut in the same commit. Default: ["CHANGELOG.md"].

format.description: changelog: `## Unreleased` moves under a dated heading. table: the file's last table gets a row like the one before, with the id counted up, today's date and the summary in the last cell.

lang.description: Takes its summary from --summary-<lang> instead of --summary, for a translated mirror.

base.description: For an overlay kit: the base kit release it needs. `kit release` refuses while the base kit's tag does not contain it.

repo.description: Git URL (or path) of the base kit.

needs.description: A commit, or a release number or ordinal word (ninth) matched against the base kit's `chore(release): <nth> <tag> release` commits.

globs.description: Globs over the repo-relative path; one without a slash matches the file name anywhere.

command.description: Run from the repo root. {file} is replaced by the quoted repo-relative path; without it the path is appended.

match.description: Files this rule lints. Left out: every edited file.
